summary: Full end-to-end verification of Equinox AI Reputation Intelligence (backend + frontend). All 34 pytest cases pass. All AI features (generate-reply, refine-reply, bulk-reply, executive-summary, ai-search, competitor-insights) return REAL source='ai' outputs from Emergent LLM key (gpt-5.4) that reference the actual review text and analytics numbers. Frontend E2E: login -> dashboard -> app selector switches KPI numbers (4.31 -> 4.35) -> sidebar nav to all 4 pages -> review dialog generates real 209-char AI reply -> AI Reply Center bulk-generate produced 30 real replies -> AI Intelligence answered 'What is our current average rating?' with '4.31' badged 'GPT-5.4'. Tenant isolation confirmed (client_member sees only 2 org apps; POST /api/applications -> 403; publish-reply -> 403 for client_member). Integrations not-connected sync returns 400 with clear message. Reports generate with kpis/topics/forecast. Brand voice persists. Loaded skills: ai-testing-core, ai-testing-llm.
ai_feature_verdicts: AI generate-reply (primary) - pass - evidence: POST /api/ai/generate-reply -> source='ai', model='gpt-5.4', reply='We're really sorry for how frustrating this has been, especially with pricing failing... Please email us at help@zenpay.io ...' (contextual to actual 1-star pricing review). skill: ai-testing-llm
AI refine-reply - pass - evidence: source='ai' on shorten action; refined reply returned. skill: ai-testing-llm
AI bulk-reply - pass - evidence: 2 real AI replies returned via /api/ai/bulk-reply; frontend Reply Queue shows 30 replies. skill: ai-testing-llm
AI executive-summary - pass - evidence: source='ai', 5 insights citing real numbers (rating 4.31, 237 reviews, 68% positive, 106 unreplied, Pricing top negative topic 38%). skill: ai-testing-llm

AI search - pass - evidence: Question 'How many reviews came in the last 30 days and what is our current rating?' -> 'In the last 30 days, you received 237 reviews. Your current rating is 4.31, which is up 0.06 over the past 30 days.' source='ai'. UI answered '4.31' for average rating. skill: ai-testing-llm
AI insights (emerging issues) - pass - evidence: /api/ai/insights returns emerging_issues + all_topics arrays populated from real topic breakdown.
AI competitor insights - pass - evidence: source='ai' with data-grounded comparison insights.

issues: Radix DialogContent console warning: missing DialogTitle (accessibility). Wrap with VisuallyHidden or add a DialogTitle. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional a11y: add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) inside ReviewDialog to silence the Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Login endpoint sets an httpOnly cookie with SameSite=None+Secure but also returns JWT in the response body (frontend uses Bearer). Two auth surfaces work; ensure logout is fine (it deletes cookie only) — acceptable but worth noting.

seed_admin: password reset branch only fires when password differs — good; existing test_credentials.md matches. No brute-force lockout is implemented (spec bullet mentions it). If required, add attempt counter + lockout in routes_auth.login.

CORS: allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' split — browsers reject credentialed requests to wildcard origin. Not currently affecting Bearer flow, but if cookie auth is ever needed cross-origin, replace with explicit origin list.
routes_ai.generate_reply overwrites review.ai_reply on every call (fine, but no history retained).
Some pages have no data-testid on primary KPI subtext (e.g., kpi-projection text is concatenated: 'Current Rating4.31+0.06'). Consider splitting for testability.
